## 📄 Spec revised — ready for your review

**Spec file**: `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`

### Changes from your feedback

**✅ Single-user, no login** — confirmed, unchanged.

**🏷️ Tags added** (new User Story 3, P2):
- Assign one or more tags per bookmark
- Choose from previously-used tags **or** create new ones
- Filter the list by a tag (and clear the filter)
- Tags combine with search; matching is case-insensitive + whitespace-trimmed so you don't get "Work" vs "work" duplicates
- Folders explicitly excluded, per your preference

**🔎 Auto-collected page details** (User Story 1 reworked):
- On save, the app fetches **title, description, and favicon** automatically
- All are **editable**, and your edits always win over fetched values
- Best-effort: if a page is unreachable or has no metadata, the save still succeeds and you fill in details manually (never blocks saving)

**🔁 Duplicate handling reversed** (FR-019):
- Saving an address you've already bookmarked **no longer creates a duplicate** — it takes you to the existing bookmark instead.

The story list is now: P1 Save-with-details · P1 Browse & open · P2 Tags · P2 Edit & delete · P3 Find. Requirements expanded to FR-001–FR-019, plus new edge cases (fetch failures, favicon fallback, tag equivalence) and success criterion SC-006 for fetch timing.
